notes.title: [Notice] [Fixed] Updates to prevent unusual acquisition of goods
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

Through the user's report today, we confirmed that certain items can be sold at a higher price than the production cost.

It occurred when the players crafted a specific item with the material they bought at the store and then identified the item and sold it to the store again.

[b]We applied an update to modify it at 4:30 p.m.(GMT+9) today.[/b]

This issue occurred due to the lower production cost in the process of lowering the quantity and grade of materials needed for item craft through the last update.

The development team sincerely apologizes that we did not check this in advance.

The price of selling items to the store, the price of purchasing materials from the store, and some of the materials needed to craft the items were modified to prevent this problem from occurring anymore.

For online mode only, if there is a players who intentionally exploited this issue to create a lot of goods, we will collect them for fairness.

However, unless it is intentionally exploited, there will be no forced collection.

Once again, we're sorry for causing trouble for your game play.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] The Announcement of the Next Update Schedule
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/1abe0eb4b7570c841f7ca632311c2fe4dad2e55e.jpg[/img]


Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter dev team.

First of all, we would like to thank you all for enjoying our game.

Today, we would like to announce the situation of the dev team ask for your understanding.

Last summer, the dev team tried to focus on developing the game, but the result was far from what we have planned. As a result, Troubleshooter has not had an update for about two months. However, we are planning to update our first DLC [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children – White Lion and Black Witch[/b] on [b]November 16, P.M 11(GMT + 9)[/b].

We are going to release the DLC for free hence there will be no extra charges. We originally planned for Bianca and Alisa to join Albus in the main episode, but due to the development schedule, we were unable to do so. [b]White Lion and Black Witch[/b] is a story about Bianca and Alisa. The episode will be playable after you finish the main episode: [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/f2e989ec4c26529b309cea7d89d8efaae2794350.jpg[/img]


[h3]1. Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children – White Lion and Black Witch DLC update schedule[/h3]

We have been planning to release the DLC earlier but have kept you waiting for a long time due to our lack of ability. We are deeply sorry about that. Currently, we have completed the base work, but we still have scenario missions and translations to do.

For the above reason, on November 16, we will be going to update the first mission of DLC, which will be a story about how Bianca and Alisa join Albus. After then, for every one to two weeks, we will be going to update the scenario mission. There will be a total of 8 scenario missions and one violent case.
We understand that you have been waiting for an update for a long time. The dev team has failed to meet the deadline. We are deeply sorry about it. However, we thought releasing playable content that is not fully prepared is the worst choice we can make. The dev team concluded to choose quality over quantity.

After we finish updating the DLC, new illustrations and BGM will be updated to the art book and the soundtrack.

We apologize for the inconvenience we brought despite all your support.

[b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children – White Lion and Black Witch DLC content guide[/b]
- 9 scenario missions (Last scenario mission of chapter 6 + all scenario missions of chapter 7)
- 1 violent case
- Level 50 items
- New mastery and systems


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/8f14aa9730a771c3060fbe24f7b29d3c8185158c.jpg[/img]


[h3]2. Troubleshooter: Banished Children update schedule[/h3]

There is no project running at the moment. Thanks to your support, we have been able to develop our [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children[/b] this year. However, developing [b]Troubleshooter: Banished Children[/b] will take at least a year, judging by the dev team’s capability.

For us, a year is a very long time. There are too many factors to consider; including the fact that we might not be able to maintain the dev team. Therefore, we cannot promise you when we will start the project. To resolve anxiety factors, we are going to mainly focus on improving [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children[/b]. We are going to improve the content and add more quests and additional elements to make the game richer.

We are sorry to let you down with the news. We will find a way to start the project [b]Troubleshooter: Banished Children[/b] as soon as we finish updating the DLC.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/e00e507525f8f096919bc77d863861130d63aac7.jpg[/img]


[h3]3. About online content[/h3]

The dev team was planning to make Troubleshooter an online game with a short story. However, going through early access, a lot of you wanted us to work on the level of completion of the game as a single play game. The dev team agreed on the idea and thus worked on improving the quality. This, however, turned out to be the reason for the failure of the dev team to provide the majority of the promised online content.

On one thought, we thought of giving up the online content. However, we believe that co-op and PVP can provide extra playable content to those who have completed the game. Therefore, we are going to work on the online part when we have the time and capacity to do it. Nonetheless, we are going to primarily focus on the DLC and online content will come after we finish updating the DLC.

We apologize to those who had been waiting for the online content.

Thank you very much.

For the above reasons, the contents that were scheduled to be developed by the end of the third quarter have been delayed until the end of October. We will announce the exact schedule after we come back from vacation.

We are deeply sorry to make such a decision, despite all the support you have shown. We will try our best to give you the best experience in return.

We always thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Proofreading Tool manual version 2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

First of all,

From the time when we released the Proofreading Tool, many Troubleshooter community members gladly provided their ideas and better translations. 

I wanted to take this opportunity to say thank you to all of them. 

Many requests to the tool has been received. We tried to apply them and many functions have been added. This is why we update the new manual.[/b]

Troubleshooter is supporting 3 languages officially and other languages are supported by unofficially. 

The team also knows that some of official translation is not such a readable. We're sorry about that.

Though the team is made up with developers and no foreign language expert, we can't give up updating the translation. 

This is why we built the Proofreading Tool. We wanted to provide you a more convenient way to access translation of the game.

Did you find out any typos, awkward expressions, or unreadable sentences? You can suggest better translation by using Proofreading Tool.

Every single suggested translation will be checked by development team and there will be a chance to share the idea of translation with other users.

We'll do our best to apply the translations you've made in the update as soon as we possible.

Why don't you join translation of Troubleshooter? :D

+ [b]If you want to join the translation, internet connection is essential.[/b]

+ [b]How to activate Proofreading Tool[/b]

Steam LIBRARY → HOME → right click Troubleshooter → Properties → Click [ SET LAUNCH OPTIONS ] on [ GENERAL ] → type [ --translation volunteer ] into the popup screen and click enter → Launch Troubleshooter

+ To deactivate Proofreading Tool, remove the [ --translation volunteer ] in the [ SET LAUNCH OPTIONS ].

[h2]Editing Dialogues[/h2]

Step 1. 
Once you activate the tool, you can see [ Support Translation ] on the bottom left corner of the game screen when a dialogue is being progressed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/735ffd9c3806c6dd19ec15703fac1373e4fb0093.jpg[/img]

Step 2. 
Click the [ Support Translation ], then [ Translation List ] window pops up. [b]This is the main screen of Proofreading tool[/b]. Please check the number mark on the screenshot and descriptions below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/6f2081269806334efbcdb8712103054a2209d981.jpg[/img]

1.) [b]Category tab: [/b]
- Mastery, Ability, Item, Buff: Regardless of what currently being listed on the screen, you can always edit names and descriptions of a specific mastery, ability, item and buff.
- Search Text: You can search sentences that include the words you've input.
- Recent Text: When you click the [ Support Translation ], main screen shows this as its default. This shows dialogues history.

2.) [b]Content box: [/b]
- Shows contents of the category you've chosen on the Category tab.

3.) [b]Page navigator: [/b]
- When the contents are too many, you can navigate them using Previous and Next buttons.

4.) [b]Keyword search box: [/b]
- If you want to look for any text that is included to Mastery, Ability, Item, Buff, you can type a specific word here and the result will be showed if there is any.

Step 3. 
If you find awkward sentences or typos in a specific sentence, click the sentence you want to edit then screen turns to the [b]edit mode[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/5492897d5eec5574ad707768ce162c10de593959.jpg[/img]

1.) [b]Current Translation:[/b] The sentence you've clicked.

2.) [b]New Translation:[/b] You can write your translation here.

3.) [b]Note:[/b] Besides the New Translation, if you want to tell anything that is related to your new translation to the development team, you can freely leave the message here. The text here won't be included to the text in New Translation section.

4.) [b]Translation History:[/b] Lists the confirmed translations.

5.) [b]Other Suggestions:[/b] If anyone already suggested new translation and it is not confirmed yet, they are listed here. You can still suggest your own translation and instead of writing new one, you can click heart icon in already suggested translation list. The sentence that has higher 'heart' count will have a higher chance to be confirmed by the development team.

6.) [b]Language:[/b] Set the language of you've input.

Once you've input new translation or click any heart icon, please don't forget to click 'Submit'.

[h2]Editing Masteries, Abilities, Items, and Buffs[/h2]

Step 1. 
In the main screen, click the Mastery(or Ability or Item or Buff) tab. ( 1 in below screenshot )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/5559b918605d6f88c062ac8e73ffdcff5d2b9332.jpg[/img]

Step 2. 
All other steps are same as Editing Dialogues.

* [b]Warning[/b]

You can see the Placeholder when you click some sentences. ( 2 in above screenshot )

For example, a sentence before you clicked could be showed like below.

『 Hit Chance increases by 1.5% per 1 currently applied Scholar, Hacker masteries. 』

But once you clicked, it will be showed like below in the edit mode.

『 $Stat$ increases by $Value2$ per $Value$ currently applied $Type$, $Type2$ masteries. 』

As you have already noticed, $Stat$, $Value$, $Value2$, $Type$, $Type2$ are placeholder. It is automatically replaced to the pre setup value when it is used in the game. You can move placeholder's position but if placeholder's format has broken, It won't be replaced to right value and it will be showed as error.

Of course all the suggested translations are checked by the development team and most error will be fixed. But please note that keep the placeholder's format right.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: [Notice] Detection of 'False Positive' in some Anti-Virus program
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

As of the update at July 17th, there are cases that some anti-virus programs are detecting some files that are related to the Troubleshooter as it is malware.

As a result of our own investigation, there was an White List database update of the [b]Bit Defender[/b] engine so that 'False Positive' has happened to those programs that have not enough usage time such as bug report program of Troubleshooter.

This change is just a progress for the Bit Defender engine to avoid the load of checking every single program so it's OK to allow bug report program of Troubleshooter in your anti-virus program.

The development team submitted the references and request Bit Defender team to register the program to their database.

Please understand that this issue was caused by outside factor so that our action is being very limited.

Thank you.

[list]Anti-virus programs that is using Bit Defender engine:
[*] This is not the whole list of the programs that are using Bit Defender engine.
[*] BitDefender
[*] VIPRE
[*] EMSISOFT
[*] BullGuard
[*] G-Data
[*] F-Secure
[*] e'SCAN
[*] QuickHeal
[*] Adware
[*] Tencent
[*] TotalDefense
[*] Virus Chaser
[*] Alyac
[*] ViRobot
[*] Turbo Vaccine
[*] nProtect
[*] Ransom Defender
[*] Qihoo 360
[/list]

If you receive a malicious code warning while using a vaccine program unrelated to the list above, we would appreciate it if you could let us know about the vaccine program you are using! And we'll ask the vaccine company to release the block of our program so that the block will not continue in the long run!!

We're really sorry to have caused you worry about this!

Thank you!

Greetings, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We understand that many of you are undergoing a hard time due to numerous natural disasters and COVID-19. How are you all fairing?

Thanks to your help and support, the development team has been working on game development.

The financial predicament, which many people concerned about, will pose no problems until the end of the year thanks to regular and summer sales.

We are grateful for all your support. We understand that our game has many flaws. The development team will do its best to compensate for all the love and support you gave. 

The following list is the first interim report of what we promised.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/932084d87ccf5de203bc23ac5c965ab40f2c353c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Additional Scenario[/h3]
We planned to update the additional scenario content, for which many of you requested and anticipated, by the end of the third quarter. However, our team is simultaneously developing existing content and additional content. The speed of development is not as fast as we expected.

This scenario will add one chapter (8 scenario missions) to the game after the ending. We are planning to release it by the end of September.

We thought of releasing the missions one by one, instead of the whole chapter at once. However, we understand that this might give new users the impression that the game is incomplete, and thus we currently have no plan to release the game in such fashion. 

However, the schedule and update method can change at any moment. Feel free to suggest your thoughts; we will contemplate your requests.


[h3]Partial controller support[/h3]
We received a lot of requests regarding the controller. The development team understands its dire need. However, implementing controller demands lots of requirements such as new UI, conveniences, etc. 

We have not had experience with controllers, and thus we are undergoing a lot of trials and errors. 

We are going to do our best to improve your experience with the controller in our game.


[h3]Online Community[/h3]
We have set the extension in online function as a long term goal. Our primary goal is to complete making the online community. Once we stabilize the game content, we are going to develop expansive content.

Many contents are delayed due to our lack of capability. We are deeply sorry for the inconvenience it caused.


[h3]Continous Feedback Reflection[/h3]
The development team is grateful for your feedback.

The members of the dev team are contemplating to reflect your feedback to satisfy all of the gamers. 

However, during this process, we understand that you can be frustrated by the dev team's slow feedback and persistence. Furthermore, some of our decision could have let you down.

The inconveniences are due to our lack of capability. Hence, we are trying to find a better way to resolve and reflect your feedback. 

Looking back into our days in development, we can feel that Dandylion is still nothing but a small and incapable development team.

However, to repay for your support and love, we will grow to be a better team to provide you with better game content. 

Thank you for your supports despite slow updates.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter Development server.

First of all, thank you for your understanding and cheer about the data issue caused by our fault on Asia server last week.

The team will keep updating the game to return all those kindness.

Thank you always for your cheer.

[h3]Below fixes and changes have already applied. We don't need server stop.[/h3]

[b]Fixed bugs:[/b][list]
[*] A bug that some units' appearance had displayed wrong.

notes.title: [Notice] I'm sincerely sorry to all Asia server users.

[h3]We sincerely apologize to Asian server players for this problem.[/h3]

Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

First of all, I'm sorry for all those whom used Asia server yesterday.

We lost some game data while resolving DB issue. [b]This is totally our fault.[/b] We tried to use every method to recover game data, but we only could get the data until 2020 July 5th, AM4.

20 hours of player data loss is critical mistake to the game that aims online service.

notes.title: [Notice] The price changes caused by bypass purchases in some countries.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/79ab56f669ae6b22706afb155f1ba463a064ef5b.jpg[/img]

First of all, We are sorry to inform you of this.

While we were checking from our official release sales until now, games were sold a lot in countries where people rarely purchased from early access to official releases.

At first, We thought this was an influx of users from new countries, but we realized through our player's report that most of them were bypass purchases that changed the national settings of Steam accounts.

We didn't have a way to stop this and Steam's recommended way was to raise prices if there were no sales in such countries. So after careful consideration of this, we made the following decision. 

We confirm that the recently released "XCOM:Chimera squad" is at a similar price to ours (a little cheaper than ours), and decide to raise the game prices in the country below to the price levels they set.

We apologize to the national users who are suffering from this.

If this price setting is unfair, please stop purchasing for a while. The price change can be changed again after 30 days, so we will consider it if you give us a lot of information to worry about.

[b]The price below has been changed the same as "XCOM:Chimera squad".[/b]
[list][*] Russian Rubles
[*] Brazilian Reals
[*] Indonesian Rupiah
[*] Malaysian Ringgit
[*] Philippine Peso
[*] Thai Baht
[*] Vietnamese Dong
[*] Turkish Lira
[*] Ukrainian Hryvnia
[*] Norwegian Krone
[*] Indian Rupee
[*] South African Rand
[*] Argentine Peso
[*] Kazakhstani Tenge
[*] SASIA - USD
[*] Mexican Peso
[*] Chilean Peso[/list]
The rest of the country remains unchanged.

We're really sorry to tell you this and We'll do our best to make a careful decision on this. 

Changes in prices will be applied after the steam is approved. 

Steam's approval will take some time and it will be the same as the previous price by then.

We're so sorry about that.

** Price Updated ** 

[h3]All of the above currency prices have been applied.[/h3]
[b]Note[/b]
The price of Ukrainian Hryvnia was entered abnormally because we made a mistake in the price change process. Thirty days after price changes are not changed and summer sales exist. We will normalize the call after that.  We're so sorry to Ukrainian users!!

notes.title: The date of full release has been postponed until April 22th, 2020.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/01b43eebeef7fbf2f1d89562da2499ea736cb547.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone. This is the Troubleshooter development team.

The development team is currently working on an ending scenario mission, fixing bugs, and applying your suggestions for translation. However, with all the work the development team is working on and due to our lack of people and capacity, we will not be able to full release on April 13th.

Due to our lack of capacity, we are putting our full release date off to [b]April 22nd.[/b]

We are deeply sorry.

According to the change of schedule, we are planning to make regular updates on April 11th and 18th and will put our full effort to make the best out of our game along the way.

All of the inconveniences you are experiencing are the result of our lack of capacity. We once again apologize and would like to remind you that we are deeply sorry for the current situation.

Additional updates prior to full release
[b]Date:[/b] Saturday, April 11th / Saturday, April 18th
[b]Time:[/b]
- Saturday 09:00 ~ 11:00 CET
- Saturday 17:00 ~ 19:00 JST
- Saturday 00:00 ~ 02:00 PST
- Saturday 08:00 ~ 10:00 UTC

To compensate for the delay of full release, we will do our best to update enjoyable game contents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/073d09eaea11536380d5e80d537ca648e49be781.jpg[/img]

We would also like to inform you of some matters the development team faces regarding full release.

[b]1. Development after full release[/b]
After full release, we will be focusing on improving inconveniences in the game and making up for the lack of game contents for a while. We will try our best to maintain the period of regular updates.
In long terms, we are going to add multi-play in some parts, partial applications of game pad, and contents we promised during early access. We will announce the development schedule regarding the above features later through road map.

[b]2. New character[/b]
As soon as our first goal is achieved, we are going to update untold stories of episode 1. And through that, you will be able to get a new character as your company. We will also inform you of this as soon as we have it scheduled out.

[b]3. About DLC[/b]
We understand that to keep our development team going, DLC is crucial. With full release, we are going to release OST along with it. We are also releasing digital artbook as soon as it is ready.
We are also enthusiastically considering costume DLC which a lot of you suggested. However, unlike other DLCs, this requires time and efforts which we are currently in short of. We will get right into it and release costume DLC reflecting various concepts you suggested as soon as the development team has the resource for it.

[b]4. Discount on Launch[/b]
From the date of full release, we are going to give you a 20% discount on our game for two weeks. The profits gained will be invested back into the development to provide you all with better experiences and more enjoyable game contents in Troubleshooter.
 
Please feel free to ask anything about full release.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: [Notice] Updated the Translation Tool
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

Since the official launch of Troubleshooter, the development team has received many opinions on translation.

Most of the opinions were pointing out wrong translation and improvement measures for better translation.

Thank you to everyone who gave us their opinions. And the development team apologizes that the team couldn't show you a better translation.

The development team thought about how to apply the translation you suggested in the game faster and more accurately, and updated the [Translation Tool] as an alternative to this issue.

The tool allows you to directly modify the translation of the game without going through the development team. The revised translation is reflected in the game with the inspection of the designated editor or the recommendation of another gamer.

If you are interested in translating the game, I would appreciate it if you could actively use this tool.

We won't be able to solve all translation issues using the tool. Above all, the first translation of the development team will be the most important. We will try to provide higher-quality translation through the issues of translation that have been pointed out so far.

+ [b]Network connection is needed to use the tool[/b]

+ [b][u]How to Use:[/u][/b]
Steam LIBRARY → HOME → Right click on the Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children → Properties → GENERAL → LAUNCH OPTIONS → Input option string [--translation volunteer] → Run the game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/be25dbeda9cb2104f264b164749a16a0d0ef8d10.jpg[/img]

+ [b]If you don't want to use the tool, remove the option string on the LAUNCH OPTIONS.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/1214ab5f01843307cff7967c163451bbe2cb4bd4.jpg[/img]
[b]1. If you have followed the above procedure, you would be seeing [ Support Translation ] on the bottom left corner of the game when there is a dialogue screen. Click it.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/9db2b1485264d5f962a609329f915a731bf5db4a.jpg[/img]
[b]2. Then [ Translation List ] pops up. The screen would be looking like the following picture.[/b]

- [b]1. Search[/b]: Searches the game’s dictionary file (dic_keyword.dic, dic_text.dic). You can search all the words and sentences in the game. The system distinguishes the lower cases from the upper cases, so be sure to type in the exact word/sentence you wish to find. If you click the list of searched results, you can access the editing screen.

- [b]2. Dialogues[/b]: This menu shows dialogues you have passed by. You can click the dialogue you wish to edit. This will take you to the editing screen.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/ec8eeb6dd40fa7ffd12019d9c4ae3eaf5c4eb61e.jpg[/img]
[b]3. The editing screen is composed as follows.[/b]
- [b]Reference[/b]: Currently selected sentence for translation suggestion. [ Translation ] is the translation. [ Original Text ] is the original Korean text.

- [b]1. New Translation[/b]: You write new translation here. After you typed in, you can click [ Submit ] to submit your suggestion.

- [b]2. Suggestion[/b]: For the selected dialogue, if there are suggestions for translation, they show up in this menu. You can always click a heart if you like their suggestions.

- [b]3. History[/b]: This menu shows dialogues which accepted suggestions and thus were edited.

- [b]4. Undo[/b]: Undo your suggestion for translation.

- [b]5. Back[/b]: Return to previous screen.


4. [b]You can always return to your game by clicking the red x button on the upper right corner.[/b]

The submitted suggestions for translation will be applied to the game according to the number of approved (that means with the most heart signs) on the nearest regular update. With that being said, the date of application of translation suggestion can vary according to the update schedules.
We wish this helps at least a little to those who are willing to give translation feedback. We are looking forward to your participation.

notes.title: [Notice] Announcing the date of Official Release and Road Maps.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/f23d213ac4fe2668a26d4fc276da62128eeaf64d.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We have planned to officially release Troubleshooter on April 13, 2020.

The road map we have planned to achieve before the release is shown below.[/b]
 
[h3][b]March Road Map[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Add quests in Shooter Street available up to level 40
[*] Add a Valkyrie shop. (You can purchase unique items that you missed out during missions)
Add scenario mission
[*] Extend company masteries and add effects according to the level of the company
[*] Apply as much user feedback as possible[/list] 
[h3][b]April Road Map[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Optimization and bug fixes
[*] Game trailer renewal
[*]Digital Artbook
[*]Apply as much user feedback as possible[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/a7ed92d478b4bb278c440c72f2ca09c42cd847fe.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Everyone who showed interests and concerns for Troubleshooter.[/b][/h3]
Troubleshooter has been available on Steam as Early Access for two years and three months. Today, we would like to talk a little about ourselves.
 
We organized team DANDYLION in an attempt to create a turn-based RPG and were able to receive feedback during the Early Access. Thanks to your support, we could share an idea and communicate for better developments. The last two years have been a great pleasure for us.
 
Our beginning was trifling.
[list][*] 2 playable characters and 6 scenario stages
[*] Less than 100 Steam reviews 4 months since Early Access
[*] Only 80% positive reviews[/list]  
However, thanks to all of your consistent participation and support during Early Access, we were able to update our game 74 times for the last two years. And Troubleshooter has seen improvements as follows.
[list][*] 9 playable characters
[*] 41 scenario missions
[*] 22 recurring quests and 10 violent case missions
[*] More than 200 cut scenes
[*] 900 masteries, modules, additional masteries
[*] Additional contents such as class changing, beast taming, crafting drones, foods
More than 1,500 Steam reviews
[*] 90% positive reviews[/list]
We sometimes had frustrating times. We even wanted to let go of our project. Nonetheless, your feedback and support kept us motivated. If it weren’t for all of you, our games would not have existed. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/f7a259278c190692f16906168e328251547a1a80.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Regarding the decision to full release and to increase the price...[/b][/h3]
 
Despite your support and devotions from all our team members, Troubleshooter development team has been suffering difficulties in maintaining the team for a long time. Furthermore, each member spent more than five years for this project and we have come to the point in which mere desires and attachment for the game cannot hold us together.
 
For the above reasons, we are properly releasing the game along with the last scenario mission of the first episode.
 
We are properly releasing Troubleshooter despite its shortcomings. We will put all our efforts to improve the upcoming scenario mission and insufficient content to make a better Troubleshooter experience.

Moreover, starting on March 12th, we are planning to increase the price to [b]25$[/b] to raise funds for game development.
 
We understand that many of you will not be happy about our decision of increasing the price for an incomplete game. We will do our best to make Troubleshooter worthy of the price by the time we release it properly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/5afe9e2abb65397234646fce96b7ba070eb43570.jpg[/img]
  
[h3][b]We are going to take every chance to carry on with the game development after the full release.[/b][/h3]

Our main goal is to maintain the team and finish our project, Troubleshooter. This, in our opinion, is the only way to make up for all the support we have received from you.
 
If we raise enough funds by the full release, we are looking forward to improving the pre-existing content, introducing various characters and classes, adding episode two, and lastly, portraying untold back-stories of our characters.
 
Furthermore, we are planning to put a digital artbook and OST on sale to raise funds.
 
We all think that such circumstances are a growing pain that indie game development studios undergo to mature: something that we should definitely overcome.
 
The full release of Troubleshooter has flaws but we will invest the utmost efforts to continue on with developing.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Game language troubleshooting guide - 26th Nov, 2019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

Recently, we've noticed that there is a bug that Troubleshooter client's language hadn't been changed other language except English. It's a bug that is caused by Steam client itself and we are waiting for Valve's answer.

If your Troubleshooter game client has not been initialized to proper language, you can fix it temporarily by following below guide.

Case 1. Checking game's default language

You can check the game's default language by following below steps.

[ LIBRARY → HOME → right click on a Troubleshooter → Properties → Language ]

If language doesn't match your language, choose it to your language in supported language list. [b]Don't forget to press OK button.[/b] 

If this doesn't work, it's Steam client's bug.

Case 2. Fixing Steam client's bug temporarily

Please follow below steps.
1. Select game's language to [b]English[/b] refer to the Case 1.
2. Turn off the Troubleshooter game client.
3. Log out from the Steam and terminate the Steam client. 
( * Please note: Not minimization. Log out and terminate. )
4. Login to Steam.
5. Select [b]your proper language[/b] refer to the Case 1. 
6. Terminate the Troubleshooter game client and logout from Steam again.
7. Login to Steam and run the Troubleshooter client.

If above methods doesn't work, please leave the messages. We can help you!!

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Enemies mastery setup in challenge mode.
notes.notes:
( This text is written with the help of machine translation service. )

Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

Recently, we've had reports about enemies in challenge mode. It said it looks enemies tend to have the same masteries repeatedly.

There was a optimization work so development team has looked into this issue and we think this could be happened when challenge mode system gives enemies masteries randomly.

We didn't expect that this optimization work could change the game experience but we now understand that this change can make players feel frustrated.

In long term point of view, optimization is essential work and it could change the logic of mastery-choice. But we'll pay more attention to its logic and the result that caused by the logic.

The changes that are triggered by this optimization can't be rolled back. But we are going to update that can make the challenge mode to be more interesting sooner or later.

notes.title: [Notice] Announcement about cheating in-game - 24th Sep, 2019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

Today, we found the action that uses weak point of game logic and gains money and goods abnormally.

The issue has been fixed and the development team has withdrawn all the properties that came from that action.

If a similar situation happens again, we promise that we are going to deal with the situation on the same principle from now on.

The development team will try everything to keep fair play condition.

We're very sorry for your inconvenience.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Server access failed of chinese players. - 22 Sep, 2019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

From yesterday, Some people in china reported about the access fail of our server. So we started to check the problem with the people who tell us the problem. And we found these problems that it caused by 'network control '.

Frankly speaking, We didn't know the reason why our server restricted by chinese internet service company. So we had to recommend them the change of network type. For example, from a wired network to wifi or from wifi to wired network.

Fortunately, this way solved the problem and they could acess our server and play game smoothly.

if you can not access our server, if possible, please change network type. And VPN off. 

Anyway, we are searching another way to solve these problem.

Sorry for inconvinience.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Update schedule announcement - 4th March, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/e49ec095ea1fb37988a036d5978b26cfd9a3bb02.jpg[/img]

Hello, this is Troubleshooter Development team.

[b]First of all, it has been decided that the update that was planned today will be postponed to this Friday. [/b]

[list]
[*] Friday 12:00 ~ 14:00 UTC
[*] Friday 04:00 ~ 06:00 PST 
[*] Friday 13:00 ~ 15:00 CET
[*] Friday 21:00 ~ 23:00 KST (GMT+9)
[/list]

We are sincerely sorry for the frequent update delays. However, we would like to explain the reasons for our delay in the update.

After Giselle joined the team, beasts became available in the office. We are hoping for the beasts to provide a new type of entertainment to the users.

A number of users have left us with valuable feedbacks for the past 2 weeks and the development team considered many opinions regarding the beasts.

We have discussed whether the beasts should be treated as just a factor of Giselle’s hunter class or treated as teammates that provide new types of enjoyment in the office.

Our conclusion was to make the beasts to provide new types of enjoyment in the office and we have decided to add the following contents.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/493b64b1b0796b6567555ce1ae92b9f6b3899904.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]1. Changes in Hunter Class Masteries[/b][/h1]
Hunter’s personalized mastery ‘Taming’ will be substituted with another mastery and it will be changed from Hunter’s personalized mastery to Hunter class ability.

With this change, beast taming and summoning/releasing will be available regardless to Giselle’s job.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/bd2d7cb7dbea685a5f4b295d10baf5f263889641.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]2. Addition in Abilities and Decrease in Stats for the Beasts[/b][/h1]
Instead of fixed abilities, all beasts will be available to select abilities according to the user’s taste through ability formation like it is with other characters.

The new abilities will range from the abilities similar to those that the characters use to distinct abilities that emphasize the characteristics of the beasts.

However, since the beasts get stronger through ability addition, there will be 10 ~ 30% decrease in the stats in respect to the type and the level of the beasts.

Balance adjustment will not end with this update and will be further improved with feedbacks to provide better contents to the users.

Because we have decided to add the above contents in this update, the development team inevitably needed extra time and unfortunately had to postpone the update.

We'll be more careful to prevent this from happening.

Sorry for your inconvenience!!

Thank you.

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/920d1db88d91a12eebc5bc943cd87bee899c0ce4.jpg[/img]
 
Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
 
Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.
 
Is everyone having a wonderful year-end time?
 
The early access of Troubleshooter,  starting from December 31st 2017, is soon greeting it's first anniversary.
 
We would like to share our future plans with you guys as we wrap up our year. :Irene:
 
(* The changes mentioned below may change due to different levels of difficulty and future development plans.)
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/8ddc28af94991c0b1475bb149d760b1bcb21d8a1.jpg[/img]
 
A year ago at this time of the moment, we were trying to release the official version of the game. :Sion:
 
We, however, weren’t capable of the many updates and some updates are even getting delayed currently. Therefore, our ‘official release’ of the game has been delayed to 2019. We are very sorry for those who are waiting for the official version of the game.
 
We will try to come back with better contents as we are late for the official release!

 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/fdebabdf78b47c7d379d6b5ccae4295f2bd756d0.jpg[/img]
 
Many were curious about the updates after the official release of the game. :Albus:
 
After the official release, Troubleshooter is planning to both provide constant updates like now and provide episode 2 if the situation for the development team allows them to stably concentrate on the development.
 
However, if the development team don’t have the capability to focus on development, we will give up on providing constant updates but instead release DLCs periodically.
 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/76cf5c8ea5dd415a7279fd6a8e7b96eaeea5fc19.jpg[/img]
 
Current scenario is about the first episode of Troubleshooter. This episode 1 will be composed of 6 chapters for the plan now. Furthermore, the end of episode 1 would mean the official release of the game for now.
 
The questions that are not answered in this episode will be solved through the additional episodes after the release.
 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/5e12cc517111f117ffcd1a4ed13405d8c1a1a1b1.jpg[/img]
 
Teammates, which is the part where everyone is most interested about now, will be added consistently throughout the scenario. This part will be constantly updated even after the official release.
 
Next teammate is planning to be updated at the end of January.
We will do our best so that the new teammate can provide a lot of fun to the users.
 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/04e72c3cd1b337d94480ef0a733f7206af7b2888.jpg[/img]
 
Throughout the year, there were users demanding for more difficult challenges than what is provided now. Therefore, we are considering on developing a raid system in which powerful boss monsters appear. If the development on this contents become stabilized, we will introduce this content at the update preview session.
 
There were also suggestions on various styles of missions in the game. Due to our lack of capability, it will take some time to provide those missions shortly but we will do our best to provide a lot of fun by reflecting those ideas on our updates.

 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/3bb59f3eb5f8e91024d83b4c4d4fad9248f77dfd.jpg[/img]
 
At the beginning of the early access, a number of users mentioned that it would be better for us to focus on single contents. We also think that single contents should be well organized so that various experiences could be provided through multiplayer mode and thus we are focusing on single contents now.
 
Hence, the multiplayer contents update is planned after the end of episode 1 of the single contents. The online content too will be developed with the feedbacks of the users.
 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/5ddcac43136ab934c84d2ef9b7445ebfac434156.jpg[/img]
 
Troubleshooter requires online network to be essential in order to provide online contents in the future. Many complaints were submitted throughout the year regarding the difficulty on having a smooth game environment on account of the players’ personal environments or the region they live in.
 
We development team is interested in developing the ‘offline’ mode to figure this problem out. Nonetheless, since a lot of effort and time is required for this mode to be developed, it would be hard for us to provide this mode soon. So we are trying to develop some solutions to resolve the problems for network delays. We are truly sorry regarding this part.
 
We are just very thankful to those who ventured ‘Early Access’ of the game with us, those who just joined the Troubleshooter, and those who are constantly supporting us for the official release of the game.
 
Thank you for letting us continue the development of Troubleshooter. :Irene:
 
We will do our best and provide with a lot of fun in return!
 
Sincerely, The Troubleshooter Development Team
 
P.S:
For more information, please visit https://steamcommunity.com/app/470310/discussions/ and add comments. We are currently answering the questions of many users through this website. If you guys have any questions or complaints, please let us know!
The details regarding the next updates will be presented in the ‘update preview’ soon.
 
We will make a better Troubleshooter for everyone.

[b][h1]Thank you very much.[/h1][/b]

notes.title: [Info] Recently updated contents.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/5b8a98321647475fe261985d0f379f7624c5aef5.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.[/b]

This notice is announcement of the content that has been updated since it was released to Early Access. 

We hope this could help to find out the changes of the game to re-visitors, beginners and the one who is playing the Troubleshooter.

[h1]Teammates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sion Bloodwalker
[*] Irene Lion
[*] Anne Macy
[*] Heixing Alley
[*] [b]The next team member will join in October.[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Playable Stages[/h1]
[list]
[*] 23 Scenario stages
[*] 12 Repetable stages
[*] 4 Violent stages
[/list]

[h1]New System[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h1][b]Class Change[/b][/h1]
[*] [h1][b]Ability Change[/b][/h1]
[*] Challenge mode 
[*] Identifying, Salvaging, Upgrading and Crafting the items
[*] Replaying scenario stage
[*] Random item shop
[/list]

[h1]Utilities[/h1]
[list]
[*] Minimap and Strategic camera mode
[*] Delegating support unit
[*] Key remapping
[*] Boosting play speed
[*] Item protection
[/list]

[h1][b]And We introduce a new contents, 'Class Change' and 'Ability Change'.[/b][/h1]

[h1]Summarization:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Class Change system has been added.
[*] It will be activated when character level reaches 15 and base class level reaches 10.
[*] Each class' upgraded classes are as below:
[list]
[*] Albus: Great Swordsman / Magic Knight
[*] Sion: Battle Mage / Black Mage
[*] Irene: Battle Mage / Martial Artist
[*] Anne: White Mage / Witch
[*] Heixing: Sweeper / Ranger
[/list]
[/list]
[*] New abilities has been added to base classes.
[list]
[*] It is automatically acquired when class level reaches certain grade.
[*] Acquiring level vary by base class type.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Detailes:[/h1]

[h1][b]1. Class Change[/b][/h1]

- We’ve updated a class change system that could bring a dynamic change to character growth. Characters should be level 15 and class level 10 or above to change class.

Two more new classes would be opened to each character and class could be changed at any moment when the player wants. For example, Albus could choose ‘Great Swordsman’ and change to ‘Magic Knight’. However, some costs would be required to change class.

Basic ability would increase and new class abilities would be activated when class is changed. Also, additional mastey slots could be unlocked depending on different classes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/3b91b80fcbb9e593bcdc4b5559b9e82c7cecda26.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/18e7bb5eab7756cd827b55d40d175ac31d4d4de9.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]2. Additional Abilities[/b][/h1]

notes.title: [Notice] Announcement on Update Schedule - 21th.Sep.2018
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Troubleshooter development team.

We would like to announce our plans on development schedule and some plan changes.

[h1][b]1. Development Team Holiday[/b][/h1]

Five days of Korean Thanksgiving Day holiday starts from September 22nd in Korea. Korean Thanksgiving Day is one of the biggest National Holiday in Korea and separated family members tend to gather in one place during this holiday. 
Accordingly, all members of Troubleshooter development team is planning on resting during this period for better updates in the future. We are planning to only focus on resolving any serious issues that negatively affect the progress in playing the game during the holiday season. Please excuse us for this decision.

[h1][b]2. Update Period[/b][/h1]

We have promised for weekly updates with new missions with the start of Early Access. However, we have decided that it would be difficult to finish some process in translation and work on some other minor issues due to the holiday season in Korea from the end of September to the beginning of October(There are two national holidays - The National Foundation Day and Hangul Day - in first and second week of October in Korea.). 
For this reason, we would like to inform that our update period has changed to once in two weeks. We will announce again if weekly update becomes possible in the near future.

[h1][b]3. Next Update[/b][/h1]

Today update will be mainly on new masteries, balance adjustments, and bug fixes. We were planning on new scenario missions; however, our schedule was delayed due to updates on bugs fixes after the “Class Change” update. 
Next update is planned on first week October. Scenario missions will be provided in the next update. Please excuse us for above conditions.

Thank You.

Sincerely,

Troubleshooter Development Team.

notes.notes:
(This notice is written with the help of a google translator.)

Hello everybody, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

[b]Issue 1.[/b]
The slow response of game speed has been reported in the recently updated mission 'Intruder' and 'The End of Warrior'.

We are looking for the cause but we need your cooperation to solve this problem more faster.

If you've experienced the slow game response while battle or looting items or acquiring masteries in mission 'Intruder' and 'The End of Warrior', please tell us tht situation.

It will be a great help if the description is filled out according to the below format.

[list]
[*] Occurred time - Local time / Country, ex. 14:24 / Korea
[*] Occurred mission
[*] Occurred location - It's good to understand to describe based on terrain feature.
[*] Freezing duration after it occurred

The recent updated stages - 'Intruder' and 'The End of Warrior' -has a lot of objects and graphical resources and required processes are far more needed than the others.

Optimization of these stages has being processed for reduce the frame drop.

This work will be done in one week and will be updated through additional update.

notes.title: [Notice!] If you've experienced network problem during play game, please let us know.
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

Recent we have got many complaint about unstable network connection while play Troubleshooter.

If you have experienced frequent disconnection or network delaying, let us know below information.

[b]Please write a reply or send information mail to system@dandylion.co.kr[/b]

1. Do you use VPN? (If yes, which VPN program do you use?)
2. How fast do you use the internet?
3. Screenshot when the problem occurred
4. Log files when the problem occurred. (See below how to send the log files.)

[b]Sending log files[/b]
There is an automatic log file sender in Troubleshooter folder. You can find it in...

LIBRARY → GAMES → Troubleshooter → Properties → LOCAL FILES → BROWSE LOCAL FILES... → Release → bin → LogTransporter.exe

Run LogTransporter.exe. You can see two blanks. Upper one is email address for receive our reply and the other one is description for error situation. If you want give us more detailed information, please check 'Include full log file'. (It takes more time) And click 'Send'.

Thank you for the cooperation.

notes.title: [Notice] [Asia Server] Announcement - Server is running - May.16th.2018
notes.notes:
(This is a sentence using a translator.)

Hello everyone this is the Troubleshooter development team.

Asia server is running properly.

Here is an overview of this case.

--
Yesterday (May 15) at about 7:30 pm server, We've known that the server has been stopped from the user's tip. We immediately checked the server status and confirmed that the master account needed to start the server is locked. 

So we contacted Microsoft Azure and talked to an overseas representative to figure out the cause (10:30 pm) However, since the problem occurred at a time outside of Korea's official hours, no real connection was made with the technical support department.

We reviewed the old Asian server's operation but decided it was not possible due to some data rollback (2:30 am on the 16th) We tried to fix it ourself through the article on the service, but the account itself was locked out and not effective.

We've tried to contact with Microsoft Korea from 9:00 am today, After that, at 11:17, engineer assignments and the problem was resolved at 1:03 PM.
--

We asked the person in charge for this cause of the problem, but they just said, ' I'm sorry for the inconvenience. '. We are going to inquire about that part again to determine the cause of the problem and consider using other server vendors.

Through this opportunity, we have come to think about more stable service and will not let our efforts for better service be neglected.

Thank you for waiting so long.

notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

The update details of this maintenance is as follows.

[list]
[*] New scenario mission 'Together Again - Ashen Park Cementery' has been added.

[*] Some boss enemy's maximum information point in 'Troublemaker List' has been decreased from 500 to 300.
[*] You can now gain Perfect/Overkill EXP when a member who is not in your company member put enemy out of action.
[*] You can put the item into inventory by pressing ESC or clicking right mouse button when you found an equipment that cannot be equipped.
[*] You can move camera by arrow keys.
[*] Some of range abilities (Ex. Albus's Gale Slash) shows its targets in target list and Action Queue.

notes.title: [Notice] Patch notes for the last two months.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/f8763a48f80d496999e75abb0d86074a98c8b05e.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We would like to summarize the updated contents for the last 2 months of our early access.

[b]New colleagues added[/b]
You can now recruit Irene as your third colleague. Irene uses a powerful melee battle style with control over fire property powers to take down enemies.
 
[b]Scenario missions added[/b]
: 8 scenario missions updated containing the stories on Albus and his background.
[list]
[*] Suburbs road of the border
[*] Until the day comes when we could walk together
[*] Jigsaw
[*] A spreading magenta
[*] Way up high
[*] The Pied Piper of Hamelin
[*] Fetter of the past
[/list]
 
[b]Repetitive missions added[/b]
:6 repetitive missions updated to help you on your character development and item collection.
[list]
[*] Fallen Leaves Park 
[*] Young-il Construction Site
[*] Silver Rabbit Park
[*] Road 114
[*] Pugo main street underground parking lot
[*] Back-streets of the Magenta Street
[/list]

[b]Improved convenience[/b]
[list]
[*] Option for controlling battle speed added.
[*] Option for skipping events added.
[*] Strategy mode camera added for viewing the whole map.
[*] 4K mode supported.
[*] Option for continuing the mission added. If you re-log in within 1 hour, you can continue the previous mission.
[/list]
 
[b]Fixed bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Client crashes due to usage of certain gaming equipment have been fixed.
[*] Loadings that take too long to load in some missions have been fixed.
[*] Administrator problems in some OS settings have been fixed.
[*] Troubleshooter Development Team. -
[/list]

We'll do our best. Please keep watching us!

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Maintenance & Hotfix Announcement - 10.02.2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. This is the Troubleshooter development team.
[b]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
First of all, we would like to apologize for not being able to provide you with a new scenario stage this week.

We were going through a renewal process on the previous missions and we wanted to update you with a new event mission in addition to the new scenario mission, but we weren’t able to complete the development in time.

Korea will be having its biggest Lunar holidays starting from Feb. 15 to 17. This is one of biggest holidays where we get to meet our family and cousins all together, and since our dev. team is composed of Koreans, we plan to take our time off during the 3 days and refresh ourselves before getting back to work. 

In consideration of the holidays, there will be small changes in the updating schedule.
- Maintenance on Feb. 14
- New scenario stage will be added
- Any hotfix if needed
- No maintenance on Feb. 16

We also plan on adding a new repetitive mission after the holidays.

Once again, we would like to thank you for your kind consideration. We hope to provide you with a game you can enjoy.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/b]

We are going to have maintenance work on the 10.02.2018, depending on your time zone(see below), a hotfix will be implemented to improve your gaming experience as well as server stability.

[list]
[*] [b]You will not be able to access the game during maintenance.[/b]
[*] [b]Please finish the missions completely.[/b]
[/list]

[b][Maintenance Details][/b]

[b]Schedule:[/b]
[list]
[*] Saturday 05:00 ~ 07:00 UTC
[*] Friday 21:00 ~ 23:00 PST
[*] Saturday 06:00 ~ 08:00 CET
[*] Saturday 14:00 ~ 16:00 KST (GMT+9)
[/list]

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Marco event stage added.
 - It activated when you re-enter the Silverlining after hire Irene.
 - This stage is not a scenatio stage.
[*] Niels the antique dealer has been added.
 - He comes to Silverlining bar after complete the mission 'Road 113 suburb road' with Pietro.
[*] Item identifying function has been added.
 - Items can be identified through Niels.
[*] Units whose level is lower than mission recommended level can get additional EXP when they put an enemy out of action.
 - The more level gap between enemy and ally unit high the more additional EXP can be gained. But can not be exceeded the 5 level gap.
[*] New Steam achivements has been added.
 - If achievements condition already met, they automatically achieved when you enter the game.
[list]
 [*] Hero Irene appears!: Complete the mission 'Young-il construction site'
 [*] Stranger: Complete the mission 'Road 113'
 [*] Endlessly falling rain: Complete the mission 'CrowBill'
 [*] Jigsaw: Complete the mission 'Pugo Shopping Street'
 [*] Spreading of magenta: Complete the mission 'Back-streets of the Magenta Street'
 [*] Hero Irene!: Recruit Irene
 [*] I am Anne Macy: Recruit Anne Macy
 [*] Impossible challenge: Defeat the Marco in 'Pugo Shopping Street' mission.
 [*] Shouting of Angry Bull in 'Back-streets of the Magenta Street' mission: Defeat the Scot
 [*] Tactical decision: Stunned more than 3 enemies at the same time with a Wind Pressure Grenade.
[/list]
[*] Event and map of Mission 'Firefly Park' has been modified.
 - Addtional masteries can be gained through this mission.
 - Ambush: Damage increases by 50% when successful attacking to a patrolling or sleeping target
 - Optimism: Vitality activated when ambition is above 50%.
 - Patience: Armor and Resistance increases by 30.
 - Guilty conscience: Maximum count of each mastery section will increase by 1.
 - All four masteries will be given to the companies those already completed this mission.
[*] Intro of mission 'Firefly Park' and 'Silverlining' has been modified.
[*] Crosshair in aiming mode now shows Hit Chance.
[*] Damage increase of Mastery 'So Close Yet Far' is changed from 10% to 7% per meter.
[*] 'Angry Bull' effect is triggered only when same clan member has put out of action.
[*] Fixed a situation that 'Angry Bull' animation activates in a row.
[*] Fixed a bug that Overcharge duration increases by 1 turn when Overcharge reached by 'Cheerfulness'.
[*] Fixed a bug that confirmation windows has been skipped when command through space key.
[*] Fixed a bug that mastery 'One Shot One Kill' activated when shoot explosives.
[*] Fixed a bug that 'Stun' status removes right after their turn when 'Stun' activated by their moves.
[*] Fixed a bug that 'Civilians rescued' count in 'Company Report' increases when 'Rescue civilians' mission has been failed.
[*] Fixed a bug that mission does not end when get a mastery from last enemy.
[*] Fixed a bug that dialog can not be skipped by keyboard input.
[*] Fixed a bug that Buy and Sell button activated when there's no item registered.
[*] Fixed a bug that occurs when using mailbox.
[*] Fixed a bug that texts of some mails from rescued citizen has not shown normally.
[*] Wrong description of 'Magma Skin' has been fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug that error window pops up when clicked another mastery right after unequip mastery.
[*] Fixed a animation when unit enters the cover right after jumping or landing.
[/list]


Thank you.

- Dandylion Dev. Team.

notes.notes:
Hello everyone. 

This is the Troubleshooter development team.

We will be having our regular maintenance for contents update and server maintenance.

[list]
[*] [b]You will not be able to access the game during maintenance.[/b]
[*] [b]Please finish the missions completely.[/b]
[/list]

[b][Maintenance Details][/b]
[b]Schedule:[/b]
[list]
[*] Friday 08:00 ~ 11:00 UTC
[*] Friday 00:00 ~ 03:00 PST
[*] Friday 09:00 ~ 12:00 CET
[*] Friday 17:00 ~ 20:00 KST (GMT+9)
[/list]

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] New scenario stage added.
- Activated when entering the Office in Silverlining after clear the 'Crow-bill station' mission

[*] You will lose the items with a certain chance when the mission fails.
[list]
[*] Quest items and items with the highest grade 'unique' grade will not be lost.
[*] Equipped items acquired from the chest will not be lost.
[*] Item loss rate is as below:
[list]
[*] Poor: 10%
[*] Normal: 8%
[*] Uncommon: 6%
[*] Rare: 4%
[*] Epic: 2%
[*] Legend: 1%
[/list]
[*] Penalty of item loss rate is changed according to mission time.
[list]
[*] Until 5 minutes after mission starts : 10 times
[*] 5 minutes ~ 10 minutes: 8 times
[*] 10 minutes ~ 15 minutes: 6 times
[*] 15 minutes ~ 20 minutes: 4 times
[*] 20 minutes ~ 25 minutes: 2 times
[*] After 25 minites: No penalty
[/list]
[/list]

[*] You can activate the warehouse. 
[list]
[*] Activation condition is as below:
[list]
[*] Items over 60% of inventory
[*] Mission 'Crow-bill station' or 'Road 113' clear
[/list]
[*] Max inventory count increases by 100
[/list]

[*] Albus's Wind Slash has 10% Bleeding chance.
[*] Game difficulty is shown in Victory condition menu.
[*] Explosive object will not explode when it attacked with ice ESP attack.
[*] Required count to next information level is shown in Troublemaker List.
[*] Clicking right mouse acts same as ESC when Silverlining menu is opened.
[*] Animation of Ambition point up/down can be skip by hit ESC.
[*] Guide message added when unit open chest in mission.
[*] Fixed a bug client crash when use a mailbox.
[*] Fixed a bug that remaining time of Activity Report doesn't match local time.
[*] Fixed a bug that some masteries can not increase critical damage.
[*] Fixed a bug that Timas running away into a bush with the stun condition still active.
[*] Fixed a bug that HP gauge does not blinking.
[*] Fixed a cover information in mission map.
[/list]

Thank you for the cooperation.

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding problems on running the game.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. This is the Troubleshooter dev team.

We want to thank you all for enjoying our Troubleshooter game.

We have been tackling the issues arising regarding the in-game problems after the release, but we are incapable of solving all the different issues happening from various environments at the moment.

We are especially aware of the client shutting down due to errors and sometimes failing to start and we consider fixing these problems as our priority. The following are the serious problems we have currently identified for now:

[list]
[*] The game won’t run.
[*] The game client shuts down during the play.
[*] The network disconnects in certain situation.
[*] The screen turns black and nothing appears on the screen thereafter. 
[/list]

To tackle the problems, we are in need of your help. It would help us a lot if you could send us the needed information when you face the problems mentioned above. Please follow the below instructions. It would be a great help in our part.

Library → Game → right click Troubleshooter → Properties → Local files → view local contents folder → Release folder → bin Folder → Protolion_log folder

Compress the Protolion_log file (zip file would be preferred!) and send it to us at [b]system@dandylion.co.kr[/b] . An explanation or a screenshot with the email would help us a lot in fixing the game. 

We will do our best to keep the game running smoothly as possible. 

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Patch note and server maintenance announcement - 2018.01.05
notes.notes:
Hello Troubleshooters.
 
We will be having our regular maintenance for contents update and server maintenance. The maintenance period will be at
 
Friday 00:00 UTC

Thursday 16:00 PST

Friday 01:00 CET

Friday 09:00 KST (GMT+9)

You will not be able to access the game during maintenance. ('Gateway server closed' message will pop-up when you try to access the game.)
 
Note:
- Please close all missions in process before the maintenance begins.
 
Patch Note:

1. New scenario mission added.
- You can now select the mission from the mission control if you have completed the ‘Road 113’ and ‘Young-il Construction Site’ missions.
 
2. Repetitive mission added.
- A repetitive mission on the ‘Road 113’ and ‘Young-il Construction Site’ will unlock when you complete the two missions.
- You can access the repetitive missions through the mission control.
- We promised there'll be 3 repetitive missions will be added. But the other one will be updated next week. We're very sorry.

3. Mission continue added.
- You will be able to continue the mission if you log-in and start the mission again within 30 minutes after the client shuts down due to errors.
- Continuing missions will not function for clients closing due to server maintenance or problems with the server.
 
4. Max level will be restricted to level 20.
- We will increase the restricted level as we increase the number of contents for the game.
- If you are above the restricted level at the moment, you will not be able to receive EXP anymore.
 
5. The ‘Unit’s Mastery Board’ will now only show masteries that can be equipped by the unit.
 
6. You can now use the mouse cursor to drag the screen.
- You can change the settings through the Options menu, the basic setting is set to WASD movement.
 
7. Scenario missions in the mission control are listed in yellow texts.
 
8. The location of the unit’s level in the mission table has been re-arranged.
 
9. New loading image added.
 
10. Some fixes on misspellings within the game.

Thank you.

notes.title: Troubleshooter is released !!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We want to inform you on some of the important issues regarding our game.


Update periods

Troubleshooter will be updating contents every week during maintenance time for the Early Access period. The game requires a network connection so you won’t be able to access the game during maintenance. The maintenance time is as follows:

Every Friday 00:00 UTC
Every Thursday 16:00 PST
Every Friday 01:00 CET
Every Friday 09:00 KST (GMT+9)

We will be updating bug fixes and at least 1 scenario stage during the maintenance, and if need be, we may notify you prehand and proceed with patches in addition to the updates from the maintenance. We hope for your kind understanding. 


Contents Development
First, we plan to update the first episode of the single-player story mode. In regards to this, we hope to receive ideas on how the missions should be structured and plan to take them into consideration in developing the contents. We will then be able to build on the cumulated contents to develop the PvP system and Co-op mode (simultaneous play with max 3 users) during the Early Access. We will inform you details on the updates together with the following week’s update plans through the announcement page. 


Communication
We will think upon and take into consideration all feedbacks provided through the channels below.

Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/BraveTroubleshooter/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BraveDandyLion
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCXfqI5ThVXWK47kbAAntulg
 
We will do our best to provide you with an enjoyable game.

Hope you have a happy new year!


The following are temporarily applied to ensure smooth game play :
- Ambition point recovers 5 points per minutes. (Originally one point per minute.)

- Dandylion.
